verdict.rationale: Asana documents multiple mechanisms for autonomous background automation: classic Rules/webhooks/API automation (asana-docs-2, asana-docs-31), AI Studio described as 'no-code automations' (asana-docs-7), and AI Teammates/agents that run inside workflows with shared memory and governance (identity, scoped permissions, audit trail, cost constraints) enabling them to act autonomously (asana-docs-5, asana-docs-6, asana-docs-12, asana-docs-13, asana-docs-42). This directly matches the story of setting up automations that run in the background without constant human intervention. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that AI Studio or AI Teammates actually execute autonomously in production (all evidence is vendor-sourced), and no community corroboration of this specific capability.
